items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs extend inflow streak to five sessions and reach record $1.22B cumulative inflows
items.summary: U.S. spot SOL ETFs added $33.5M on Aug. 24, the largest daily inflow this year, extending a five-session streak and lifting cumulative net inflows to a record $1.22B. Trading volume reached $166.8M, the highest since October 2025.
items.whyItMatters: The five-day inflow streak and record cumulative flows strengthen evidence of regulated institutional demand for SOL while governance proposals simultaneously affect supply economics.
items.actionReason: Strong institutional flow supports the backdrop but does not override Crypto Reca location, trigger, R/R or hard gates after SOL's sharp advance.

items.headline: Bitcoin rises above $80,000 to a more than three-month high
items.summary: BTC moved above $80,000 after a sharp August advance. ETF flows remain supportive while sticky inflation and elevated long-end yields remain macro risks.
items.whyItMatters: The break reinforces trend participation but also raises mean-reversion and poor-location risk for fresh longs.
items.actionReason: Trend strength is context only; fresh Crypto Reca location, trigger and R/R remain controlling.

items.headline: Solana validators vote on proposals that could accelerate inflation decline and sharply increase SOL fee burns
items.summary: Validators are voting on proposals including SGP-0002 to accelerate disinflation and SGP-0003 to change fee burns. The measures remain proposals, not enacted policy.
items.whyItMatters: If approved, the proposals would materially alter SOL supply economics.
items.actionReason: The catalyst supports the backdrop but does not remove execution gates.

items.headline: Crypto exchange volumes double in five days as market activity rebounds
items.summary: Centralized-exchange trading volume roughly doubled over five days to above $37B after a yearly low, though it remains below the prior 12-month peak.
items.whyItMatters: Recovering spot activity improves liquidity and participation context.
items.actionReason: Participation context only; no hard gate changes.

items.headline: Strive acquires 1,110 BTC for $81.5 million, lifting holdings to 21,356 BTC
items.summary: Strive disclosed purchases of 1,110 BTC between Aug. 17 and Aug. 21 at an average price of about $73,409.
items.whyItMatters: Additional corporate treasury accumulation supports BTC institutional-demand context.
items.actionReason: Corporate demand does not replace Crypto Reca execution gates.

items.headline: Weekly altcoin ETF flows favor XRP and SOL, with smaller AVAX inflows
items.summary: Block Scholes reported weekly net inflows of about $39.8M for XRP, $28.3M for SOL and $1.3M for AVAX for Aug. 17-21.
items.whyItMatters: Positive regulated-product flows support liquidity and demand context.
items.actionReason: Setup-specific structure and timing remain controlling.

items.headline: Bitmine adds 32,447 ETH and reports holdings above 5.84 million ETH
items.summary: Bitmine Immersion said it acquired another 32,447 ETH over the prior week, taking total holdings to 5,847,611 ETH.
items.whyItMatters: The purchase adds institutional demand context for ETH.
items.actionReason: Positive treasury demand does not override timing or risk gates after a sharp ETH advance.

items.headline: Strategy raises about $2 billion through MSTR sales but makes no bitcoin purchase and builds a new USD Cash pool
items.summary: Strategy reported no bitcoin purchase or sale for Aug. 17-23 despite raising about $2B through MSTR sales.
items.whyItMatters: The absence of fresh buying removes a marginal demand source while preserving future purchasing capacity.
items.actionReason: Do not treat the purchase pause as an exit signal.

items.headline: Bitcoin posts largest weekly dollar gain on record after 22.7% advance
items.summary: Bitcoin gained $14,264 during the week ended Aug. 23 and closed at $77,387, a 22.7% seven-day rise.
items.whyItMatters: Record momentum supports trend but increases chase and mean-reversion risk.
items.actionReason: Record momentum is not an execution trigger.

items.headline: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs posted their strongest combined inflow week since October 2025
items.summary: U.S. spot BTC ETFs recorded about $1.9B of weekly net inflows and spot ETH ETFs about $697.2M.
items.whyItMatters: Renewed institutional spot-ETF demand supports liquidity and trend persistence.
items.actionReason: Supportive context only; require Crypto Reca confirmation before adding.

items.headline: Solana mainnet begins staged slot-time reduction toward 200 ms
items.summary: Solana cut mainnet target slot time to 350 ms as part of a staged reduction toward 200 ms.
items.whyItMatters: Lower slot times can improve confirmation latency and network competitiveness.
